overview: Host John Petrella interviewed former City Council President Rick Caraviello for the inaugural 'Medford Good Neighbor' series. Caraviello discussed his decades of community volunteering, City Council service, and efforts to establish the new Medford Public Library and Medford Arts Center.

items.title: Introduction and Personal Background
items.summary: Host John Petrella introduced the series and welcomed lifelong Medford resident Rick Caraviello to discuss his community involvement.

items.title: Medford Kiwanis and Chamber of Commerce Involvement
items.summary: Caraviello detailed his 33-year involvement with the Kiwanis Club and his service as president and interim executive director of the Medford Chamber of Commerce.

items.title: Community Food Drives and Veteran Support Projects
items.summary: Caraviello highlighted community food packing drives through Kiwanis and coordinating volunteer contractors to install accessibility equipment and remodel homes for disabled local veterans.

items.title: City Council Tenure and Mayoral Campaign
items.summary: Caraviello reflected on serving 12 years on the Medford City Council, including three terms as council president, and his subsequent mayoral campaign.

items.title: Medford Public Library Building Project
items.summary: Caraviello discussed securing state grant funding, collaborating with former Mayor Stephanie Burke and Library Director Barbara Kerr, and raising $6 million through the library foundation to construct the new facility.

items.title: Securing Space for the Medford Arts Center
items.summary: Caraviello described partnering with former Councilor Michael Marks to negotiate 5,000 square feet of rent-free space from a local business to establish a municipal arts center.

items.title: Citizen of the Year Award and Closing
items.summary: Caraviello reflected on receiving the Medford Chamber of Commerce Citizen of the Year award and encouraged residents to submit community nominations for future honorees.
